name: Legal business names accept common period punctuation
description:
Objective: Legal business names accept common period punctuation.
Preconditions: Open Add Application with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Add Application.
2. Legal business names accept common period punctuation.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: A legal name ending in "Inc." is kept verbatim and does not block Save.
